gloss_en: Issue statuses in Solibri change after syncing to BIMcollab
title_original: Why is issue-status in Solibri changed after synchronization to BIMcollab?
question_paraphrase: my custom Solibri statuses turn into Active after sync, why
phrasing_notes: FAQ-style 'Why is...' title, product names, no context
answer_summary: BIMcollab supports only three statuses; unrecognized ones map to Active unless value conversion is configured.

gloss_en: Selected/colored components from Solibri are not visible in other BIM tools
title_original: Why don't I see selected/colored components in other BIM tools?
question_paraphrase: components I colored in a Solibri viewpoint do not show in another tool
answer_summary: BIMcollab stores selected vs colored components; Solibri saves clicked items as colored and basket items as selected, and some tools handle only one type.

gloss_en: After importing BCF issues into Solibri the viewpoint components are missing
title_original: Why are viewpoint components missing after an import?
question_paraphrase: imported BCF into Solibri and elements in the viewpoints are gone
answer_summary: Solibri drops components not in the loaded models; load latest models first, discard the presentation and re-import.

gloss_en: Issues will not export from Solibri to BIMcollab; projects not listed
title_original: Solibri BCF Live Connector tips and troubleshooting
question_paraphrase: cannot push issues to BIMcollab from Solibri and the project list is empty
answer_summary: Causes: duplicate title, title over 250 chars, non-https server URL, proxy option, missing admin rights; disable auto sync and mark issues ready only when complete.

gloss_en: Issue data was overwritten by Solibri
title_original: Why was my issue data overwritten by Solibri?
question_paraphrase: my edits to issues in BIMcollab got overwritten after Solibri sync

gloss_en: Issue numbering in Solibri differs from BIMcollab project
title_original: Why does the issue numbering in Solibri differ from my BIMcollab project's?
question_paraphrase: issue numbers do not match between Solibri and BIMcollab

gloss_en: Not all issue properties are available in Solibri
title_original: Why aren't all issue properties available in Solibri?
question_paraphrase: some BIMcollab issue fields are missing in Solibri

gloss_en: Should I import BCF/CSV issues via Solibri or via BIMcollab?
title_original: Should I use Solibri or BIMcollab to import issues from BCF or CSV?
question_paraphrase: which tool should import BCF or CSV issues
phrasing_notes: 'Should I use A or B' comparison

gloss_en: After publishing a Solibri presentation all modifications appear under my name
title_original: Why are all modifications on my name after publishing a Solibri presentation?
question_paraphrase: after publishing a presentation every change is attributed to me

gloss_en: After ExtractElements, transparent cavity walls turn opaque beige in Solibri
title_original: ExtractElements drops occurrence IfcStyledItem on MappedRepresentations (transparent walls become beige in Solibri; Bonsai looks fine)
question_paraphrase: after extracting elements from an Archicad IFC4 model, styles are lost and Solibri shows opaque beige walls
answer_summary: Occurrences end up on unstyled representation-map copies; Solibri colors from material only while Bonsai resolves via type.

gloss_en: Tool lacks geometric clash detection and duplicate/overlapping element checks that Solibri and BIMcollab Zoom have
title_original: Clashdetectie en dubbele elementen
question_paraphrase: wants clash sets, duplicate or overlapping elements (same class, near-identical geometry, duplicate GlobalId), grouped per storey
context_given: benchmarks vs Solibri intersection rule with tolerances
phrasing_notes: Dutch spec with Waarom/Nu/Gevraagd/Klaar als structure
answer_summary: Proposes ifcclash-based hard clash and clearance sets, grouped results, BCF output.

gloss_en: Color and filter elements by any property like Smart Views (fire rating, NL-SfB code, missing LoadBearing)
title_original: Kleuren en filteren op eigenschap (Smart Views)
question_paraphrase: viewer only colors failing elements red; wants color per property value with legend and counts
context_given: Smart Views and Solibri checking views as benchmark
answer_summary: Proposes filter plus color rule, legend with counts, bundled views, storable as BCF viewpoint.

gloss_en: Find duplicate elements
prompt: any duplicate elements in the arch model? same class same spot, list them w/ guids
expected_behavior: Detect elements of same class with near-identical placement/geometry or repeated GlobalId; list GUIDs, names, storeys.

gloss_en: Check required properties on walls
prompt: run the usual check: every IfcWall has FireRating, IsExternal and LoadBearing filled? give me fail count per storey
expected_behavior: Check Pset_WallCommon properties exist and are non-empty, count failures by storey, list examples.

gloss_en: Classification completeness
prompt: how many elements have no classification reference at all? by IFC class pls
expected_behavior: Count elements without IfcClassificationReference, group by class, report percentage.

gloss_en: Invalid classification codes
prompt: NL-SfB codes in here are all filled but are they actually valid codes?? check against the list
expected_behavior: Extract classification codes, compare to a supplied code list, report invalid or malformed ones.

gloss_en: Hard clashes between ducts and beams
prompt: clash ducts vs structural beams, 10mm tolerance, group by level. dont give me 300 lines for one duct run
expected_behavior: Run clash between duct segments/fittings and beams with tolerance, group by storey and system.

gloss_en: Why is wall opaque
prompt: why do my cavity walls show opaque beige, they were see through in archicad. style issue?
expected_behavior: Inspect IfcStyledItem on occurrence and type representation maps and material styles; report which carries transparency.

gloss_en: Compare versions
prompt: compare v12 and v13 - what got added, deleted, changed properties
expected_behavior: Compare two IFC files by GlobalId, report added, removed, modified elements and property deltas.

gloss_en: Check georeference
prompt: are the 3 models on same coordinates? one seems to be 40 km off
expected_behavior: Compare IfcSite RefLatitude/Longitude, IfcMapConversion and bounding box origins across models.

gloss_en: BCF export error
prompt: solibri wont push issues to bimcollab, says error, project list empty. what do i check
expected_behavior: Explain causes: duplicate title, over 250 chars, https URL, proxy, admin rights, auto sync.

gloss_en: Compare spaces with dRofus program
prompt: do room areas in the model match the dRofus program? flag >5% off
expected_behavior: Compare IfcSpace net floor area with supplied program values, flag deviations over 5 percent.

gloss_en: Elements not in storey
prompt: anything not assigned to a storey? doors w/o host too
expected_behavior: List elements lacking spatial containment and openings/doors without host wall.

gloss_en: Proxies count
prompt: how many proxies and from what revit categories
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy grouped by Revit category/ObjectType.

gloss_en: Which tool for what
prompt: do I need Solibri if I already have simplebim and zoom? what does each one do for IFC QA
expected_behavior: Explain roles: Solibri rule-based checking, Simplebim data fixing, Zoom BCF issue handling.

gloss_en: Fix properties
prompt: fill empty IsExternal on walls from the type name containing 'EXT' and save as new ifc
expected_behavior: Set IsExternal true where type name contains EXT, otherwise leave, export new file, report counts.

gloss_en: Accessibility
prompt: can u check door clear widths and corridor widths vs accessibility rules
expected_behavior: Compute door clear widths and corridor widths where possible, compare to a given threshold, note limits.

gloss_en: Smart view by fire rating
prompt: color elements by FireRating, grey for empty - and tell me how many are empty
expected_behavior: Group elements by FireRating value, report counts including empty, suggest color mapping.
